### 1 of 1. 1 old design note in doc/specs is marked as fully replaced

### What was found
One file, doc/specs/retired-widget.md. Line 3 of its opening block says it is fully replaced by doc/specs/widget.md. No other card involves this file. README.md is the only file outside the design-note and plan folders that mentions it by name. The newer note in doc/specs also mentions it.

### Why it matters
The housekeeping rule for design notes flags notes marked as fully replaced, because a reader can still find and follow the outdated one, from housekeeping's reference/base-rules.md, Specs section.

### What happens if you accept
With Fix, the old note is removed on its own branch and you receive one pull request against the default branch. README.md still mentions the old note, and someone has to decide what it should say instead. That is a design choice, so filing a ticket is recommended.

Pick one:
1. [ ] Fix - Build this class in its own worktree and open its own pushed PR against the default branch; leave the primary's tracked files unchanged.
2. [ ] Ticket - file one ticket listing them and change nothing now [recommended]
3. [ ] Ignore - leave them as they are
